# Original Delta Force map tool

Source: https://df.qq.com/cp/a20240729directory/index.html
Retrieved: 15 September 2026. Exact resource URLs are listed in `sources.json`.

This folder contains the original Leaflet engine, map configuration, sectors,
POIs, vehicle/deployment data, floor data, styling, jQuery and Swiper used by
Tencent's published tool. Existing copyright/license notices are retained.
CSS resource URLs are made absolute so assets resolve from this local page.

`../index.html` retains the original map interface and controls. Analytics,
social-sharing scripts and the original mobile redirect are omitted. The
community adaptation is in `../official-*.js` and `../official.css`.

Map tiles and icons load on demand from Tencent's original CDN, as on the source
website. This requires internet access. The snapshot includes 14 published
Warfare maps, their PC/Mobile and Attack & Defend/King of the Hill variants, plus
the original Operations maps/floor controls. It does not promise future parity
with Tencent releases or that every China-region map is in the global game.

This is an unofficial SCP community adaptation; Tencent/game artwork remains
owned by its respective owners. Keep attribution and the original source link.
